summary: The out/ build I was asked to confirm (06bd0f2cab76ce9b) is clean. The round-4 major is fixed: every plate 3MF now has a settings entry for each of its parts (plate_1 2/2, plate_2 4/4, plate_3 3/3) matching PRINT_SETTINGS.md. ring_low is at 30 %, the edge-distance note is in DESIGN.md, and every requirement and FEA passes (twr 2.08 / 1.86, mass 780.5 / 790 g). But that build is stale. The current inputs fingerprint to 721479e716c80d8c because commit f118ac0 (pan_tilt session, 10:36) added fdm_holes self_tap_pilot_horizontal to the catalog and made iface use it for every teardrop tap. That changes tvc_drone's horizontal M2 servo-tab taps, and the 10:44 build did not include it (hardware.json was rewritten at 10:46 by the rebase). The current geometry has not been built or checked, so it cannot pass.

findings.issue: `kerf review-status tvc_drone` reports geometry 721479e716c80d8c, but out/report.json is 06bd0f2cab76ce9b; `kerf status` shows 'build PASS (stale)' and 'eval FAIL'. The difference is the catalog/iface horizontal self-tap pilot from f118ac0: the teardrop M2 taps (yoke_servo in ring_low, ring_servo in gimbal_outer) change size. The current geometry has no check, renders or FEA.
findings.fix: Run `.venv/bin/kerf build tvc_drone` on the current tree and confirm the M2 tab taps still pass the fastener and holewall checks. Then re-review. I expect a PASS if nothing else moves. Note: the ring_low/ring_mid/ring_top lock taps use features.teardrop_hole with screw_spec('M3')['tap'], not the new 'tap_h', so they do not get the horizontal pilot. Decide whether they should, for consistency.

findings.issue: The FEA uses a solid model and the print is 30 % infill with 4 perimeters. lug_fea is 7.88 vs 13 MPa. I accept 30 % + 4 walls without a modifier, given the SF 3 load case.
findings.fix: Optional: add a PRINT_SETTINGS / DESIGN note to use a >= 50 % infill modifier on the three leg lugs if there is filament to spare.

findings.issue: Carried over: 14 first-layer edges cannot take the 0.5 mm chamfer (deburr warning).
findings.fix: Deburr after printing or use slicer elephant-foot compensation.

findings.issue: Carried over: leg_fea deflection is 2.966 vs 3.0 mm (99 %); accepted.
